links.outcome: Model AUROC on contaminated ECG images when trained with vs without perturbation augmentation
links.effect: Models trained on augmented datasets generalized better to perturbed data; best model reached AUROC 0.894 on the contaminated test set; perturbation-trained models had highest average IoU of 0.399.
links.quote: Our experiments demonstrate that models trained on augmented datasets generalize better to perturbed data, with the best-performing model achieving an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.894 on the contaminated test set.

unlisted_practices: Training-data augmentation with image perturbations to improve robustness
LIME-based explanation stability (IoU) analysis under perturbations

screen.reason: The study develops and benchmarks deep learning models with XAI for ECG image analysis under perturbations, focusing on model robustness and explanation stability rather than organizational deployment practices or workflows.
